The merge in step 2 is computed sequentially against the already-modified tensor rather than against the unmodified base: `tmp = b + λ(f1 - b)` followed by `tmp + λ(f2 - tmp)` yields `(1-λ)²·base + λ(1-λ)·ft1 + λ·ft2` = `0.36·base + 0.24·ft1 + 0.40·ft2`, whereas the required formula `base + λ(ft1 - base) + λ(ft2 - base)` yields `0.20·base + 0.40·ft1 + 0.40·ft2`. This is exactly the ordering hazard the specification warns about ("each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base"), and it violates the "Required result" clause 2; the resulting 48 merged tensors will not be within the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance of the reference. The verification, count checks, and output layout are otherwise correct.
